skill.summary: High-ticket lead qualification agent for realtors and property managers. Handles inbound inquiries from Zillow/Realtor.com, qualifies for budget and timeline...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Real Estate Lead Qualifier with ThumbGate Fair-Housing Safety

- Provides instant 24/7 lead responses for realtors and property managers from Zillow/Realtor.com inquiries.
- Qualifies leads based on budget (with a minimum floor), pre-approval status, and move-in timeline.
- Schedules viewings directly into the agent's calendar, pending qualification.
- Incorporates ThumbGate to ensure strict compliance with Fair Housing laws by blocking and redirecting disallowed questions.
- Requires pre-approval letter upload and budget compliance before booking viewings.
